update_md5_181a2786404f64d818180cfeb21ae.name: ui_remove_cfonts_import
update_md5_181a2786404f64d818180cfeb21ae.semantics: Remove cfonts import; direct console output inside Ink can break interactivity in some terminals.

update_md5_181a2786404f64d818180cfeb21ae.name: ui_remove_console_banner_effect
update_md5_181a2786404f64d818180cfeb21ae.semantics: Remove effect that calls console.clear/log after Ink render, which can leave the UI looking frozen and unresponsive.

update_md5_229397e0cc5a20796798ed4323fd7.name: ui_add_simple_header
update_md5_229397e0cc5a20796798ed4323fd7.semantics: Add an Ink-rendered header (no console IO) to keep a visible title without breaking input.
